capabilities: Renumber headings automatically as sections are added, moved, or deleted
Fill skipped heading levels with a zero segment
Configure a trailing dot on first-level heading numbers
extras: Numbering is written into the note text itself, so it survives in any Markdown editor or export; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in heading numbering, so keeping hierarchical section numbers consistent by hand is tedious and error-prone.
summary: Heading-numbering plugin that automatically renumbers Markdown headings hierarchically in real time as you add, move, or delete sections.
